title: WorkflowRun
description: Immutable identity and durable orchestration binding for one WorkOrder. Engine-native Continue-as-New segments do not create additional Platform WorkflowRuns.
x-semantic-constraints: work_order_id is unique and binds at most one WorkflowRun; a WorkOrder that terminates before orchestration start may have none
the WorkflowRun is created after orchestration start confirmation and before provider or Sandbox admission, so admission failure remains representable without a fabricated AgentRun
